quora-conversions-api: Only the exact /ads/v0/conversion URL and existing JSON payload signature are selected. Neighboring routes stay uncovered. Bare URLs cannot prove HTTP transport or body correctness.

New POST, Bearer, JSON MIME, body-presence and decoded-encoding checks are advisory. They follow the official server template pinned at ce40ee26f9a62eb1dc3a84889a4797a6e1a8e4b4, not a complete receiver specification. Missing or redacted capture evidence retains engine availability semantics.

The public Redoc wrapper was read, but its linked OpenAPI YAML returned HTTP 403 through an ordinary fetch and an ordinary unauthenticated browser request. No full receiver schema was read or inferred.

Existing event body contracts remain. Empty user objects, zero and signed values, unknown extension fields and events without click attribution remain permitted. The official template documents no-qclid acceptance; no universal click ID requirement is added.

User identifier hashing rules, token validity, account ownership, timestamp age, consent configuration, event deduplication, attribution and receiver acceptance require external evidence. No JWT grammar or hard producer-only required fields are invented.
cm360-tracking-ad: Only exact trackimp and trackclk route families, optionally prefixed by /ddm/, are selected. Similar names and unrelated paths stay uncovered.

Eight existing singleton key-value parameters gain duplicate-assignment warnings following Google guidance. Empty assignments and macro assignments still count. The check uses the matrix parser and does not claim bare matrix flags or arbitrary extensions are singleton fields.

Generated empty privacy slots, unresolved template macros, legacy unprefixed tracking routes and repeated unknown extension parameters remain permitted. Each duplicate warning targets the submitted assigned occurrences.

ord is not made universally required on click tracking. Account/creative ownership, cache-buster randomness, runtime macro expansion, child-treatment decisions, consent, impression counting, attribution and delivery require external context.

producer_controls.result: Unmodified pinned sandbox source executed with stubbed server GTM APIs and sendHttpRequest. All request bodies are synthetic. This proves emitted format, not receiver acceptance.

review_notes: No raw vendor source or article snapshot is distributed. Primary URLs and digests identify local review evidence.
Low field counts in script loaders are not sufficient evidence of missing checks. Taboola S2S and Quantcast public field tables were inspected before selecting concrete gaps in these two packs.

No shared engine behavior changes. Duplicate checks reuse max_occurrences, including percent-decoded names and empty or macro assignments. New integration tests protect capture availability, extraction, targets and matching boundaries.
